# City of Orem Secure Services

> > Official secure portal for City of Orem, Utah municipal services including utility billing, justice court payments, business licensing, and facility reservations.

This portal provides authenticated access to essential city services for Orem residents and businesses. Services include utility account management, justice court case processing, cemetery records, business license payments, park reservations, and agreement approvals.

## Key Topics

- City of Orem
- Orem Justice Court
- Utility Billing
- Business Licensing
- Online Payments
- Municipal Services
- Orem City Cemetery
- Family Fitness Center
- Park Reservations
- Citation Payments
- Agreement Approval
- Cemetery Records
- Authentication System
- Municipal Portal

## Utility and Payment Services

- [Utility Billing Portal](https://secure.orem.org/UtilitySite): Orem City utility billing and customer account payment portal
- [Business Licensing Payments](https://secure.orem.org/Blpayments): Business licensing and online payment portal for Orem, Utah

## Justice Court Services

- [Citation Payment Portal](https://secure.orem.org/jccardSite/default2.aspx): Orem Justice Court citation lookup and fine payment portal
- [Court Request Forms](https://secure.orem.org/PS/ApplicationRTJ.aspx): Justice Court request form for pleas, extensions, and case filing

## Parks and Recreation

- [Park Reservations](https://secure.orem.org/FCAppX/Home/ParkReservation): Park and pavilion reservation system for City of Orem facilities

## Administrative Services

- [Agreement Approval System](https://secure.orem.org/AgreementSite): City of Orem agreement approval and authentication system
- [Cemetery Records](https://secure.orem.org/CeSite): Orem City Cemetery burial records and database lookup service
